channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Parcel E1
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Parcel E1 (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E1: The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the 2033 date comes from the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance. That was wrong. The Port's 2017 staff report (Item 9B, p.7) puts the Schedule of Performance in the Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA) between the Port and the developer, which is a different agreement from the Development Agreement between the City and the developer. The report says the developer must complete phase 2 within 16 years of project approval, but it never states the year 2033; 2033 is Pier & Point's own arithmetic (2017 plus 16 years). It stays labelled a legal outside date, not an expected completion.

The Port's report suggests but does not state that E1 is a Phase 2 parcel. It remains labelled a legal outside date, not a forecast.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E1: The 2033 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 2 within 16 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E1: The 2033 completion milestone is now labelled a soft 2017 outside date that down market delay has tolled and Port Item 11A proposes to reset, not a current expectation. The Item 11A milestone is dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report rather than as a hearing that took place. Image credits no longer say 'adopted 2017' or give an unstated Aug 11 meeting date, and the SUD land-use plan credit now notes the SITELAB logo on the sheet. The map notes cite the Port for current status and no longer claim the site was never subdivided by the Assessor. The D4D source is no longer called an 'adopted' document, and the Mayor's signing entry now states the Board of Supervisors' first-reading vote on Oct 31, 2017 and final passage on Nov 14, 2017.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel E1: The DDA's Schedule of Performance sets completion of Phase 2 at 16 years after Project approval; Pier & Point's arithmetic from 2017 gives about 2033 (the Port's report states no calendar year). Item 9B does not list parcels by phase; its Table A ties a Phase 2 benefit (Building 21) to this parcel's temporary certificate of occupancy, which suggests but does not state that E1 is a Phase 2 parcel. Not a current forecast for this parcel, which the Port's proposed 2026 phasing plan groups with E4 and Building 21 in subphase 2C (~2033)
